pull.title: MINOR: Propagate ClusterInstance#createTopic errors and clean up callers
pull.body:
ClusterInstance#createTopic and #createTopicWithAssignment did not wait
for the CreateTopics result, so a failed creation was hidden behind the
60s waitTopicCreation timeout, or ignored if the topic already existed.
They now call get() and wrap the cause in a RuntimeException.
InterruptedException is rethrown as InterruptException, so callers no
longer need to declare checked exceptions.

Also removes the now redundant throws clauses, assertDoesNotThrow
wrappers and pass-through helpers, and a duplicate createTopic call in
PlaintextConsumerTest#testSeek.

Follow-up to #23513.

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>, Ken Huang
 <s7133700@gmail.com>

reviews.body: Thanks for @lytt925 update, one minor comment

Could you also remove the `throws` clauses that are no longer reachable? A few were missed:

- `ProducerFailureHandlingTest`: `createInternalTopic` and its two callers
- `ResetIntegrationTest`
- `TransactionsTestHelper`: the five timeout / `testEmptyAbortAfterCommit` helper methods. The `throws Exception` on their call sites in `TransactionsTest` and `TransactionsWithTieredStoreTest` is redundant as well.
- `ConfigCommandIntegrationTest`, `ResetConsumerGroupOffsetTest`, and `TopicCommandTest`

commit.message:
Call get() in ClusterInstance#createTopic helpers to propagate errors

ClusterInstance#createTopic and #createTopicWithAssignment did not wait for
the CreateTopics result, so a failed creation was hidden behind the 60 second
waitTopicCreation timeout. Call get() so that the real error is surfaced.

These are setup helpers that are expected to succeed, so ExecutionException
and InterruptedException are wrapped in RuntimeException (restoring the
interrupt flag) instead of being declared.

- PlaintextConsumerTest#testSeek created the same topic twice. The second
  call used to fail silently and now throws TopicExistsException.
- Remove the assertDoesNotThrow wrappers that only existed to handle the
  checked InterruptedException.

issue.title: MINOR: Propagate ClusterInstance#deleteTopic errors and use it in more tests

repository.name: kafka
repository.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

issue.body:
Follow-up to #23699 to apply the same changes to
ClusterInstance#deleteTopic.

ClusterInstance#deleteTopic did not wait for the DeleteTopics result, so
a failed deletion (e.g. the topic did not exist) was either ignored or
hidden by the waitTopicDeletion timeout. It now calls get() and wraps
the cause in a RuntimeException, so callers no longer need to handle
ExecutionException and InterruptedException.

- Use ClusterInstance#deleteTopic in tests that delete a topic and then
immediately wait for the deletion.
- Rename ClusterTestExtensionsTest#testVerifyTopicDeletion to
testDeleteTopic and verify that deleting a non-existent topic fails with
UnknownTopicOrPartitionException.

Reviewers: Ken Huang <s7133700@gmail.com>, Chia-Ping Tsai
 <chia7712@gmail.com>
